title: Industrial Automation Reference Table (Goods and Services) — version 189-r24
description:
An open technical reference of industrial automation goods and services families (189 items: 134 goods, 14 integrated systems, 27 software/platforms, 14 services), with Iranian 8-digit customs tariff codes (Export and Import Regulations Book 1405), EU Combined Nomenclature (CN 2026) codes with identical HS6, ISIC Rev.4 / Rev.5 and WZ 2025 activity codes, technical features, standards, protocols, Purdue level and RAMI 4.0 layer. Includes a static Persian search interface, a structured JSON knowledge package, and a matching report for 64 submitted HS codes.

This is a technical reference of automation families, not a customs ruling for any specific product. SHA-256 of the Excel source file: 4df7ca41a2b8885e2f8358a2e5f44da10dad2657fbfb1bbc570b3d9b864f42ce.
